findings.summary: Without a lock, purge_expired can race with revoke on another thread; revoke pops the token from _by_token, so purge_expired's `del self._by_token[session.token]` raises KeyError. That aborts the purge partway and leaves _items and _by_token out of sync.
revoke uses list.remove, which is O(n); this matters only with many live sessions.
purge_expired deletes from the middle of a list, which is O(n²) in the worst case; a dict or a single list rebuild would be O(n).
